$description: Template kits: page patterns composed only of system components and semantic tokens. Check K1 keeps this list in step with src/patterns.

kits.title: Sign in
kits.summary: Help people sign in or create an account, with password visibility, single sign-on, and a place to explain errors.

kits.title: Settings
kits.summary: Group preferences by topic so people can find, change, and save them.

kits.title: Data table
kits.summary: Help people find orders, narrow the list by status, and select the rows they want to act on.

kits.title: Dashboard
kits.summary: Give your team one place to check progress, review recent activity, and act on orders.

kits.title: Profile
kits.summary: Let people update their public profile and see which services are connected.

kits.title: Docs article
kits.summary: Help readers follow a guide with a contents sidebar, diagram, code sample, and links to what comes next.

kits.title: Onboarding
kits.summary: Guide someone through their first setup, then show what to do in an empty workspace.

kits.title: Form states
kits.summary: Compare default, disabled, invalid, and read-only controls to check tokens, focus, and right-to-left layout.
